name: A latte Love
source:
You’re currently a university student in a small town.  College is expensive, so you got a job at one of the local cafes.  Unexpectedly, you are tasked with creating a new item for their fall menu on your first day!  

As you work at the cafe, you come to fall for one of the many unique personalities that frequent it.  In a stroke of genius (or stupidity) you decide to create your drink based around your crush… and eventually use said drink to confess at the end of the week.  

[From [url=https://pachwoom.itch.io/a-latte-of-love]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你目前是小镇上的一名大学生。大学学费不便宜，所以你在当地一家咖啡馆找了份工作。没想到，第一天上班，你就接到任务，要为秋季菜单设计一款新品！

在咖啡馆工作期间，你渐渐喜欢上了常来的某位独特客人。你灵机一动（也可能是一时糊涂），决定以心上人为灵感调制饮品，并打算在周末用这杯饮料向对方告白。

[来源：[url=https://pachwoom.itch.io/a-latte-of-love]Itch.io[/url]]
